item.title: Race Condition (TOCTOU) Remediation: What Actually Worked in a Real Stack
item.description: The same check-then-act race keeps appearing across services: purchase-limit bypass, one draw used by many requests, duplicate coupon cancellation, daily-reward overruns. I built a real stack (nginx + Tomcat×2 + shared Postgres + Redis) and measured which fix actually holds. Most of them need no Redis lock — just a DB conditional UPDATE and an affected-rows check.
